gaps.quote: Each output therefore lands at the bit-reversed position of its index.
gaps.note: Only the first layer is described: it fixes the lowest bit b of the output index in the highest address bit. That does not give the conclusion that the whole index is bit-reversed. The page never says that later layers place the next frequency bits in the next lower address slots (paper lines 2848-2868, where slot rev_a(j) is derived by induction over the levels). The page also never says that the array's address slots are numbered or that the two paired inputs differ in the top address bit.
